Based on the search results, here's a summary:

Sabrina Carpenter's album "Man's Best Friend" debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 chart, earning 366,000 equivalent album units in its first week. This marks her strongest sales week to date and the third-largest of 2025, behind only Morgan Wallen and The Weeknd.

This is Carpenter's second consecutive chart-topping album, following "Short n' Sweet" in September 2024, which opened with 362,000 units. Man's Best Friend notched 2025's biggest week for an album by a woman, by units and by album sales, while claiming the third-biggest week of the year among all albums.

Based on the search results, here's a summary of Sabrina Carpenter's "Short n' Sweet" album and its Billboard success:

Sabrina Carpenter's sixth album, Short n' Sweet, debuted at Number One on the Billboard 200 albums chart, marking a career-defining moment in her climb to pop superstardom. This accomplishment marks Carpenter's first No. 1 album of her career.

Short n' Sweet debuted with 362,000 units, a 20 times increase from her previous album, 2022's Emails I Can't Send. Sabrina took the number one spot by just 1,000 units over Travis Scott's "Days Before Rodeo."

The album went on to have strong chart performance, with Short n' Sweet notching its third consecutive week at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 albums chart. The album had a fourth nonconsecutive week atop the Billboard 200 following its initial three week run at No. 1 after its release back in August.
